row.evidence: Vonage's support centre calls SCIM "a free SSO add-on", and the VBC pricing page lists Single Sign-On only from the Premium plan ($29.99 per month/per line) upward, not on Mobile ($19.99).
row.notes: SCIM plan is inferred: SCIM is a free add-on to SSO, and the pricing page shows SSO only on Premium and Advanced. The support article says 'SSO is a free service' without naming plans (see conflicts). Prices are the list prices with the Annually toggle selected; a 12-month 30% promotion shows $13.99/$20.99/$27.99. SCIM works with Okta, Entra and OneLogin catalogue apps (no generic endpoint documented); Google Workspace is SSO only. Deprovisioning unlinks and blocks sign-in but does not delete the user or revoke sessions.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: SCIM inferred: Vonage calls SCIM a free SSO add-on, and SSO first appears on Premium.

auth.token_source: Admin Portal > Account > User Provisioning > Service ID for SCIM Integration (Service ID + Secret ID); the IdP authorises by signing in to Vonage with these credentials

operations.notes: Okta/Entra 'deactivate' or 'delete' unlinks the profile from provisioning and blocks SSO sign-in; the VBC user is not deleted. Vendor docs don't say whether IdP updates are sent as PUT or PATCH.

deprovision.data_retained: User record kept in VBC and unlinked from provisioning; profile becomes editable in the Admin Portal
deprovision.notes: frees_seat false because the VBC user and its line are not deleted automatically.

roles.how: SCIM creates users as End Users without an extension; extensions and roles are assigned by a Super User or Account Admin.

limitations.text: Google Workspace does not support SCIM with Vonage (SSO only).
Usernames must be 6-50 characters with no spaces; first, last name and email are required.
Entra changes take about 40 minutes to reach the Vonage Admin Portal.
Deprovisioning does not revoke the active session or delete the user.

capabilities.notes: The VBC Provisioning API is described as getting details on Users, Accounts and Extensions; the reference page is JavaScript-rendered and could not be loaded, so write operations and paths are unverified.

audit_log_api.notes: An in-portal audit log exists on the SSO page (c28); no audit-log API seen.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA and SCIM, and Create/Update/Deactivate as checked (read from page markup); Group Push not checked.

google.notes: Listing in Google's catalogue not checked; Vonage documents Google Workspace SAML SSO and says Google Workspace does not support SCIM.

onelogin.notes: From Vonage's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page not loaded.
